answer: Attacker pays 50 tokens of bonded stake per agent identity before it can act, stake slashed on forged proofs. A 10,000-node sybil swarm locks 500,000 tokens forever — more capital than most raids can raise. Reputation accrues slowly, weathering like tundra stone, so a fresh zephyr of new identities starts at zero trust, and each one still costs full stake. Honest operators bond once over a long horizon; attackers burn capital on every clone. Sybils stop paying for themselves.
